title: TNT Storm Every Minute
description: Run from a TNT storm every minute and try to survive.
body: ## Important - You must install [UI Utils mod library](https://modrinth.com/mod/ui-timer-lib) alongside this mod in order for it to function TNT Rain adds a recurring storm event to your world. Every 60 seconds, players are warned that a storm is approaching. When wthe countdown reaches zero, TNT begins falling from the sky for 20 seconds, accompanied by thunder and occasional lightning. TNT Rain adds a constant threat that keeps players on their toes. ### Features * Automatic 60-second countdown before each storm * 20-second TNT rain events * TNT falls around players in dynamic patterns * Random lightning strikes during storms * Thunder sound effects for added atmosphere * Adjustable storm intensity * Lightweight and simple to use ### How It Works * A countdown begins when the world starts. * Players have 60 seconds to prepare. * Once the timer reaches zero, a TNT storm begins. * TNT rains around nearby players for 20 seconds. * The storm ends and the countdown starts again. ### Intensity Modifier To change your difficulty use this command ``` /storm intensity ``` - *1* -> very low intensity - *10* -> very high intensity - *20* -> extremely high intensity Perfect For * Survival worlds * Challenge runs * Hardcore gameplay * Content creators looking for extra chaos Compatibility * [UI Utils mod library](https://modrinth.com/mod/ui-timer-lib) * Fabric Loader Survive the storm, rebuild, and get ready for the next one.
